request.initial_prompt: Benvolio. Here were the servants of your adversary And yours, close fighting ere I did approach. I drew to part them, in the instant came The fiery Tybalt, with his sword prepar'd, Which, as he breath'd defiance to my ears, He swung about his head, and cut the winds, Who nothing hurt withal, hiss'd him in scorn. While we were interchanging thrusts and blows Came more and more, and fought on part and part, Till the Prince came, who parted either part.

raw_segments.text: Benvolio, Here were the servants of your adversary And yours, close fighting ere I did approach.
I drew to part them, in the instant Came the fiery Tybalt, with his sword prepar'd,
Which, as he breath'd defiance to my ears, He swung about his head, and cut the winds,
Who nothing hurt withal, hiss'd him in scorn. While we were interchanging thrusts and blows
Came more and more, and fought on part and part, Till the Prince came, who parted either part.
